provenance: every observational value carries a JSON pointer (query items: one row-level pointer per item whose keys match the source keys); file and sha256 once per input block; array element i = pointer/i. failure_policy: any violation -> coded failure, exit 2, no bundle written; unexpected exception -> exit 3; existing output refused
open_issues: OPEN-1..OPEN-10 under /open_issues/items; ref_files pins the ledger and correction; ledger refs are item indices checked in range

provenance_classes_0346.PRIMARY-STATED: stated in a primary source document (e.g. Leroy ReadMe Note 2 "Including helium.")
provenance_classes_0346.SECONDARY: value taken from a secondary local note, program freeze or audit; primary verification OPEN
provenance_classes_0346.PROGRAM-DECLARED: convention declared by a program protocol (e.g. 1.25e20 per Msun/pc^2; S2 working plane)

supersedes: SOURCE_BUNDLE_FIELD_CONTRACT_V003.json (preserved). Only write/publication behaviour and adapter pin change; allowlists, validation and bundle content unchanged.
parsing: JSON parsed with duplicate-key rejection (E_JSON_DUPLICATE_KEY) and NaN/Infinity rejection (E_JSON_NONFINITE_TOKEN); all regexes ASCII fullmatch

write.rule: nothing is ever unlinked, moved or overwritten (CURRENT_INSTRUCTIONS "Do not delete, move")
lifecycle: preflight (validation phase): refuse if <output> or <output>.candidate already exists (lexists, incl. dangling symlinks)
build the complete bundle in memory and validate everything
re-read the candidate; require byte equality with the in-memory bundle (sha256 reported)
publish by exclusive hard link candidate -> <output> (fails if <output> exists)
re-read <output>; require byte equality; report candidate and output paths, sha256 and bytes, and same_file
write.result: on success both names exist and are the same file with identical complete bytes; the candidate name is retained permanently
write.bundle_schema_label: unchanged NGC3198_SOURCE_ONLY_BUNDLE_CANDIDATE_V002 (bundle content format unchanged; only the adapter sha recorded inside changes)

exit.4: FAILED_PUBLICATION (candidate may remain; no success claimed)

failure_codes.unexpected: E_UNEXPECTED (exit 3): e.g. filesystem without hard links, missing/read-only output directory, oversized integer literal

VALIDATION.files: no candidate and no output are created

PUBLICATION.report: publication object: candidate_path, candidate_created, expected/candidate sha256 and bytes, output_path, output_published, error type
